name: update-organization
description: Update an existing organization by replacing all its fields (PUT method - full replacement). Requires the organization ID and complete organization data (name and description). Both fields must be provided even if only one is changing. Returns the updated organization with new updatedAt timestamp.

id.description: Unique identifier of the organization to update (required). This is the ID of the organization you want to modify.

name.description: New name for the organization (required, 1-255 characters). Must be unique across all organizations. This replaces the current name.

description.description: New description for the organization (optional). This replaces the current description. Can be an empty string to clear the description, or omitted to leave it unchanged.

annotations.note: PUT replaces the entire resource. All fields (name and description) should be provided. To keep existing values, first fetch the organization with get-organization, then submit the update with modified fields.
